label: The VCVS branch row
subgoals: Write the VCVS constraint as a linear equation in node voltages
Place plus and minus one at the output nodes and minus and plus mu at the controls
Mirror the output entries into the branch-current column

label: Counting unknowns with controlled sources
subgoals: Add a branch for each voltage source, VCVS and inductor
Exclude current sources, VCCS and passive R and C

label: Solving an ideal amplifier stage
subgoals: Use the branch row to fix the output voltage
Compute the current delivered into the load
Apply the SPICE sign to report the branch current
